decisions.reason: Premium customer support remains very close to the firm's core service and operational know-how, so despite weaker standalone visibility the firm can still learn from and profitably embed it in its hosting offer.

The software version management tool draws directly on the firm's platform, in-house development, and customer administration capabilities, which gives it enough absorptive capacity to refine and retain it even if it is no longer prominently marketed on its own.

The data processing contract tool is far from the firm's main hosting and support knowledge base, and its continued absence from the site suggests limited ability or incentive to improve and commercialize it further.
Scalable hosting for agencies fits the firm's core customers, infrastructure, and stated strategic direction so closely that management would be very likely to continue it as a flagship line.
